headline: Southern Illinois goes the season without a draw
dek: Southern Illinois has turned all of its matches into wins or defeats, winning fifteen and losing five while scoring 35 goals and conceding seventeen. Every other program in the conference has drawn at least once.

pattern.text: The scoring sits at the top of the chart: Drake alone has scored more than UIC and UNI together.
